extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.notes: slender straight steel thrusting blade with soft central ridge and a blunt ball tip, swept brass hilt with long crossguard and ball ends, knuckle bow to the pommel, two front guard rings and a curved side bar, leather grip with brass wire spiral between brass ferrules, pear-shaped brass pommel; lies flat on the ground (z = 0), long axis = X, tip towards +X, knuckle bow towards -Y; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
